big: Mobile phones moved from rapid growth to a mature, replacement-driven market. Online payment apps changed how people pay. To judge an industry, combine size, competition, cycles and policy into one view.

lines: How do I put it all together?

Trace the value chain, where each step adds value and takes a share of profit. Place the industry in its life cycle: birth, growth, maturity, decline. Compare the company with peers. And watch for disruption, new technology that upends how profit is earned.
